name: Lapidary
author: E. T. Carter
description: A cut gemstone — an icosahedron shaded flat per facet so each face catches the light as a hard plane, edges sparking white where two facets meet, with a slow iridescent fire that drifts across the stone as it turns.

params.label: Fire
params.effect: Iridescent dispersion — how strongly each facet splits the palette into shifting spectral colour.

params.label: Cut
params.effect: Sharpness and brightness of the edge sparkle where facets meet; low is a soft seam, high a hard glint.

params.label: Light
params.effect: Key-light strength and facet contrast, from flat and even to deep and dramatic.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the camera around the gem; 0 ignores the mouse.
